Hi everyone!

I’m Srishti . I recently graduated in July 2026 with a degree in Computer Engineering and am currently exploring Lean 4 and formal verification.

My background is in Rust, cryptography, zero-knowledge proofs, and zkVMs. I’ve built a small STARK-based zkVM from scratch, implemented a KZG polynomial commitment scheme, and worked on EVM opcode testing and execution semantics.

I’m now learning more about formal methods, SMT, and how Lean can help improve the correctness and security of software and cryptographic systems.

I joined this community to learn, contribute to open-source projects, and connect with others interested in Lean and formal verification.

I’d love to hear about beginner-friendly projects or ways I can contribute. Looking forward to learning with you all!
I am new here. What is meaning of signal shot?

This is a project to verify the libsignal implementation, starting at the rust code, and going all the way to protocol verification. It is being run in the channel that I linked to above. It might fit the interests you have described.
Okay! I look forward to it. Thankyou!
